newsitem.title: POLAND: New car sales in Poland up 41.6 pct yr/yr in Jan.
newsitem.headline: New car sales in Poland up 41.6 pct yr/yr in Jan.

text.p: New car sales in Poland soared year-on-year 41.6 percent in January, continuing to show the biggest growth rate in Europe, an independent monitoring agency reported on Monday.
A monthly survey by the private Samar agency, which monitors the domestic car market, showed 41,323 new passenger and delivery cars were registered last month, compared with 29,188 in January 1996.
The Polish unit of Fiat Spa maintained its lead but saw its market share shrinking to 29.4 percent from 39.1 percent in January 1996.

Second-biggest seller Daewoo-FSO, the unit of Korea's Daewoo Corp also saw its market share falling, while General Motors' German unit Adam Opel AG, ranked third, boosted its market share to 7.2 percent from 4.5 percent.
